summary: iter441 — Storage-listing-level Buyer's Premium (%) override. Backend pytest suite 8/8 PASS: POST creates listing with custom_buyer_premium_rate=0.15; GET /api/checkout/fee-breakdown honors custom rate 0.15 (BP=$7.50 on $50 hammer, not the 5% default); PUT accepts 0.08 (persists); PUT rejects 0.30 -> 400 bilingual buyers_premium_rate_out_of_range; PUT rejects 'abc' -> 400 bilingual invalid_buyers_premium_rate; PUT null clears override and fee-breakdown falls back to 5% platform default; non-owner PUT returns 403; normal non-storage listing without BP still uses the 5% default. Frontend Playwright verified: BP input (data-testid='buyers-premium-input') visible+enabled on /create-listing?type=storage_locker; after FR toggle label='Prime de l'acheteur (%)', placeholder='Laissez vide pour utiliser le taux par defaut (5 %)', help text French. LOCKED notice (data-testid='bp-locked-notice') renders for regular seller on default /create-listing (bp-input=0). Vehicle /vehicle-auctions/create, multi-item /create-multi-item-listing and vehicle-multi-lot /vehicle-multi-lot/create show ZERO bp-input (regression preserved).

minor.issue: Preview-env edge cache briefly shadows recent PUTs. Cache-busted GET (?_nc=<random>) returns fresh data; PUT response itself is fresh (backend re-reads from Mongo). Not a code bug in the feature, but read-after-write tests must bust the cache.

flagged_semantic_quirk: Confirmed: passing explicit 0 as buyers_premium_rate is treated the same as null (silent fallback to platform default) because shared.calculate_standard_checkout uses `> 0` guard. Left as-is per review-request note.
flagged_data_note: testseller@bidvex.com returns is_storage_facility=true in /api/auth/login (leftover iter212 auto-flag). Does NOT leak the BP input because the frontend gate drives isStorageLocker from the URL/checkbox, not from the user field. Locked notice still renders correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: shared.calculate_standard_checkout uses `custom_buyer_premium_rate > 0` — combined with PUT storing None on blank, operators cannot force a genuine 0% override. If that's a valid use case (promo storage auctions), change guard to `is not None`; mirror same fix in stripe_connect_service.calculate_general_checkout.
GET /api/listings/{id} appears cache-fronted at edge; consider Cache-Control: private, no-store on this route so mobile/checkout consumers don't see stale BP rates after a seller edit.
